# Overtime isn’t just 1.5× the base rate.

> Free calculator for Davis-Bacon / prevailing-wage certified payroll: checks whether a worker's cash wages plus fringe meet the wage determination, and computes overtime correctly when part of the fringe is paid in cash instead of a bona fide plan.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Hosted product

- [PayApps for specialty subcontractors](https://payapps.marisstella.app/?signup&from=certified-payroll-calculator): pay applications, retainage, change orders and a weekly WH-347 per job, with the California, New York, Washington and Illinois state files made from the same week. Open now, free on one job with no card; lien waivers, QuickBooks and job costing are in paid plans that are not on sale yet. More: https://marisstella.app/industries/construction/
